name: Middleware_FreeTier_BlockAll_Returns503_ExceptAllowlisted
description:
What: Verify FreeTierGuardMiddleware blocks all except allowlisted paths.
Steps:
1) Configure options: Enabled=true, BlockAllTraffic=true, AllowPaths=['/healthz'].
2) Call middleware for '/' and '/healthz'.
Expected: '/' returns 503; '/healthz' passes to next.
